name: get_finding
description: Reads one audit finding of the active tenant by its id (for example F-20761): its statement, check, record key, state, conclusion and the facts the check recorded, and the run its check reads with the system on each side (run.sides.FILE_1, FILE_2).

name: find_lookalikes
description: Lists findings of the same check with the same conclusion (sameCause) and with a different one (controls), so a rule can be checked against both before it is proposed.

limit.description: At most this many of each list, 1 to 200 (default 50).

name: inspect_record
description: Reads one record from a connected system by key, through a catalog read that returns only status, type, date, amount, id and SKU fields.

readId.description: A read of the read catalog.

key.description: The value of that read's lookup key field.

name: search_knowledge
description: Searches the knowledge base (product facts and the active tenant's own) for entries that match the words.

limit.description: At most this many entries, 1 to 25 (default 8).

name: get_audit_settings
description: Reads an audit's settings: its name, schedule, and each statement with its checks and the run each check reads.

audit.description: The audit's code, for example month-close.

name: propose_exclusion
description: Drafts leaving records out of a check: values added to an exclusion on one side of the check's run. Nothing changes until a person approves it. Every record id in it must be one the person typed, the open finding's own, or already in the config; any other id blocks the draft. An empty string or list means not given.

name: propose_statement_narrowing
description: Drafts narrowing what a statement covers on one check: the diff types or rule ids it keeps. Which causes count is not set here: an expected cause is the run's (propose_expected_causes). Nothing changes until a person approves it. Every record id in it must be one the person typed, the open finding's own, or already in the config; any other id blocks the draft. An empty string or list means not given.

name: propose_expected_causes
description: Drafts marking causes (conclusion codes the check's run concludes) as expected for this tenant: no statement counts a finding of an expected cause, on this check and on every other check that reads the same run. The codes are added to the run's expected causes. Nothing changes until a person approves it.

name: propose_fix_text
description: Drafts new fix wording for one conclusion of a run. Nothing changes until a person approves it. Every record id in it must be one the person typed, the open finding's own, or already in the config; any other id blocks the draft. An empty string or list means not given.

name: propose_conclusion_rows
description: Drafts rows in a run's own conclusion tree (a cause with its conditions). Nothing changes until a person approves it. Every record id in it must be one the person typed, the open finding's own, or already in the config; any other id blocks the draft. An empty string or list means not given.

name: raise_ticket
description: Raises a ticket for Darpan staff when the request needs code (a new or wider cause, a missing field, a new system, a product bug, a display change) or a lever the tenant cannot change yet, rather than a config change.

name: ask_human
description: Asks the person one question the data cannot answer, optionally with choices. Ends this step until they answer.

options.description: Choices to offer; empty for none.

name: request_more_evidence
description: Asks the investigator for one more piece of evidence before a change or ticket can be written. Ends this step.

need.description: What is missing, in one sentence.
